note: Runs directly as the image's elasticsearch user (uid 101), so the entrypoint skips its chown and gosu steps: gosu (an old Go binary) aborts under Rosetta on Apple Silicon with `runtime: failed to create new OS thread (have 2 already; errno=22)` (real install run 8). The data volume is a bind directory under runtime/volumes/; on a Linux host whose uid is not 101 it needs the same owner step as wiki_static (ADR-06 follow-up, hardening target M4).
